title: Certificate of Obligatory Festivity
subject: SECRET SANTA
citation: for drawing a name at random, spending precisely the agreed limit, and feigning surprise with a conviction bordering on the professional.

title: White Elephant Champion
subject: UNDISPUTED
citation: for identifying the one desirable item in the pile and taking it from a colleague without visible remorse. A tactical masterclass.

title: Certificate of Surviving Another Year
subject: ANNUAL RENEWAL
citation: for remaining employed, largely upright, and only moderately worse than at the start of the period under review.

title: Certificate of Attendance
subject: THE OFFICE PARTY
citation: for arriving, standing near the food, speaking to three people, and leaving at the earliest defensible moment.

title: World's Okayest Gift Giver
subject: CERTIFIED
citation: for a gift that was purchased, wrapped, and delivered on time. Thoughtfulness was attempted. The receipt has been retained.

title: Certified Mum
subject: FULLY ACCREDITED
citation: for advice dispensed regardless of demand, a freezer of unidentifiable containers, and being right an insufferable amount of the time.

title: Certified Dad
subject: FULLY ACCREDITED
citation: for jokes of consistent quality, lights switched off in unoccupied rooms, and an encyclopaedic knowledge of alternative routes.

title: Certificate of Marginal Improvement
subject: YEAR IN REVIEW
citation: for measurable progress in at least one area, offset almost entirely by regression in several others. On balance: encouraging.
